fields.FIR_Description: It was alleged that the complainant reported that a shop near Selvapuram Puram Main Street in Vellore was occupied without a valid agreement and the occupant refused to leave. The matter was brought to Vellore North PS on 2026-04-18, while the incident was placed on 2026-04-12 at approximately 17:15. The complaint mentions Udhay Anand, who was reportedly contacted on 9000000125, in connection with the events. Janani Krishnan (9000000357) noticed the incident and may be able to provide a statement. A further person, Kavitha Sri, a co-worker, using the number 9000000129, is stated to be associated with the incident. Items referenced in the complaint: a witness statement, physical documents and photographs.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Occupant reportedly refused to vacate despite repeated requests.
